title: Chapter 201: War Breaks Out
content:
Chapter 201: War Breaks Out

After a night of accumulation, the number of Zerg puppies in the Zerg territory has exceeded one million.

All of these Zerg puppies will participate in today's battle.

They, together with hydralisks, cockroaches, destroyers, and stealth spiders, form the Zerg ground combat force, and follow Wu Qing's Zerg clone to fight against the bear goblin tribe.

The mighty Zerg army passed through Guangfu City. The Daxia cavalry and the alliance army, who had received the news long ago, were already waiting outside the city.

When they saw the scale of the Zerg army and the newly emerged Zerg combat arms, they were shocked and proud.

There was no face-to-face communication, and the marching speed of the Zerg army did not slow down. After the Daxia cavalry and the alliance army joined the Zerg army, they tried their best to keep up with the marching speed of the Zerg army.

The Daxia cavalry led by Wu Cong, all of whom rode Zerg war horses, had no problem keeping up with the marching speed of the Zerg army.

Those alliance troops that could not keep up with the marching speed of the Zerg army could only follow slowly behind, and there was no military order requiring them to arrive at the battlefield when.

Menghe and all the alliance lords needed to command the march of the alliance army on the spot. The alliance army had no combat mission today, so they did not lead the elite troops to follow.

Wu Qing notified the alliance army to participate in this war purely to let them be spectators.

It would be a pity if there were no spectators to help promote such an opportunity to show the powerful strength of the Zerg.

If time was not tight, Wu Qing would even want to invite the Naga tribe, the Goblin Chamber of Commerce and the Tengu tribe to watch the battle together.

…

When the Zerg army arrived near the city where the bear goblin army was gathering, the bear goblin army, which had a premonition, had already mobilized troops to deploy troops.

The three hundred thousand spirit god green army directly under the army was very vigilant, and the Zerg flying dragon group had been hovering in the nearby sky and did not launch an attack.

The city where the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department is stationed is not big and has weak defense capabilities. If more than one million troops enter the city and crowd together to defend the city, not only will their own combat power not be fully exerted, but it will also easily cause huge casualties when facing various lethal attacks.

Therefore, the army of the bear goblin tribe is the best choice to fight outside the city.

With 300,000 troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department as the core, nearly one million ordinary troops of the bear goblin tribe assist, under the command of the powerful evil god priest, backed by the city, set up a battle formation outside the city.

More than one million Zerg ground troops arrived, black and dense, with no end in sight.

The Zerg ground troops quickly deployed their battle formations opposite the army of the bear goblin tribe, outside the range of the heavy crossbows of the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department.

More than 5,000 Zerg destroyers chose their combat positions, each of them separated by a certain distance, and the formation was sparsely arranged.

Among them, those larger high-star destroyers looked particularly conspicuous.

There are only 20,000 Zerg Hydralisks in front of the Destroyer, serving as the last line of defense to protect the Destroyer. They are also the air defense force of the Zerg ground forces. They are deployed in the center and can provide air defense firepower for the entire Zerg army.

Five thousand Zerg cockroaches are divided into two teams and deployed on both sides of the Zerg Hydralisks. They are no longer dispersed to fight together with the Zerg puppies.

More than one million Zerg puppies are distributed around more casually. Their battlefield positions may change at any time, and the deployment of troops does not need to be too rigorous.

300 stealth spiders, which are not highly concerned, keep shuttling among the Zerg puppies, sneaking to the front of the Zerg battle formation and burrowing underground to lurk.

The Zerg that burrows underground cannot be harmed by conventional attack methods.

The battlefield is surrounded by Zerg hosts. They are the eyes of the Zerg. Zerg with complete air superiority can move freely.

Wu Qing took ten guards and did not enter the battle formation of the Zerg ground forces. Instead, he chose a high ground to overlook the entire battlefield.

The Zerg army does not need him to personally participate in the battle, unless he wants to charge into battle himself.

Through the Zerg host, he can clearly see the battle formation deployment of the bear goblin army on the entire battlefield.

The 300,000 direct troops of the Spirit God Green Department did not gather together, but were divided into square formations of 100,000 soldiers each, deployed in the center army and the left and right front formations of the large formation.

Their deployment divided the direct troops of the Spirit God Green Department into three points, forming a triangle, and used their heavy crossbows to provide effective anti-aircraft firepower for the large formation of the entire bear goblin army.

As long as the battle formation is not chaotic and the entire army advances in formation, the direct troops of the Spirit God Green Department on the left and right front formations can use the long-range attack of the heavy crossbows to launch a preemptive strike on the enemy.

The three direct troops of the Spirit God Green Department are accompanied by powerful evil god sacrifice teams, who can bless them with powerful divine arts at any time.

Facing such an army of the evil god camp, if the Zerg still only had two arms, the Zerg Zergling and the Hydralisk, they would be completely targeted. No matter how many Zerg troops rushed up, they would all die.

This was a special deployment made by the Bugbears against the Zerg. Unfortunately, in just a few days, the Zerg had developed to a state they did not recognize.

The speed of the Zerg's development was beyond their cognition, even beyond their cognition of their belief in gods.

This information gap was sometimes fatal.

Facing the powerful Zerg flying arms and those new Zerg arms that were not simple at first glance, the Bugbears could only bite the bullet and fight according to the predetermined plan.

Do your best and obey destiny!

Once you do what you need to do, the rest will be left to the gods to bless you!

There are 300,000 troops directly under the Green Department of the Spiritual God with luxurious equipment, as well as a super lineup of sacrificial teams. Although unexpected situations have occurred, the bugbears still have a certain degree of confidence in a head-on battle.

The battle formations of the Zerg and Bugbear clans have been set up. Nearly three million troops from both sides are spread out in the wilderness. At a glance, it is boundless!

There are 60,000 Zerg flying dragons and other flying units flying in the sky, blocking out the sky and the sun!

The alliance army that came behind saw such a magnificent scene, including the alliance lords like Meng and Hu Wei, they were all excited!

"Look! Those flying in the sky seem to be the migratory birds we saw yesterday!"

"What a flock of migratory birds! As soon as I saw the characteristics, I knew that this is the flying unit of the great Zerg! This is the flying unit!"

“It’s really hard to imagine a duel with such a lineup!”

"The Zerg are too powerful!"

"..."

Many soldiers in the alliance army were talking in low voices. They had long forgotten the fatigue of high-speed marching, and they were now full of morale.

"A battle of this scale is really rare!"

"The development speed of the Zerg race is really too fast!"

"The Zerg have this kind of strength, and the Tengu are no longer enough!"

"With so many flying units, they are enough to sweep across this area!"

“I’m so glad we made our choice!”

"..."

The lords of the Menghe Alliance couldn't help but sigh.

…

Before the Alliance troops could get into formation, the war broke out!

"Peng Peng Peng...!"

Five thousand Zerg one-star destroyers launched an indiscriminate artillery attack on the phalanx of the bugbear army!

The command and formation speed of the Zerg army is very fast. Even when the bugbear army starts arranging their troops long in advance, their speed is still not as fast as the Zerg army.

The bugbear army and some ordinary troops were not fully deployed, so they were attacked by the Zerg's fierce liquid fireball shells!

The one-star strength destroyers have increased in size and their strength has been comprehensively improved.

Their two most important capability indicators, range and explosive power, have been greatly enhanced compared to non-star destroyers.

Five thousand liquid fireball cannonballs fell evenly into the army formation of the bugbear clan with a strength of millions, and a violent explosion occurred!

The ordinary army simply could not withstand such an attack. The ordinary army soldiers in the center of the explosion turned into light and disappeared!

Soldiers from the army directly under the Green Ministry of the Spirit used heavy crossbows to intercept these high-speed flying liquid fireballs. However, the interception effect of the crossbows was not good, and not many liquid fireballs were successfully fired.

Those liquid fireballs that flew over the bugbears' army, and the big explosions that occurred when they were shot in the air, were equally lethal.

The soldiers of the army directly under the Green Ministry of Spiritual God, faced with this fierce explosive attack, jumped off the dragon mount one after another, using the body of the dragon mount and the shields in their hands to resist the impact of the explosion and avoid the super corrosive mucus. body.

Only the soldiers at the center of the explosion and their ground dragon mounts were unable to react in time. Many were severely injured by the explosion, and some even died directly and disappeared in a flash of light.

Those evil god sacrificial teams lit up with the light of faith energy, and the magical magical shield blocked the explosive attack.

Faced with this ultra-long-distance attack, the evil god priests of the Bugbear clan began to bless the army with defensive magic, especially for the soldiers directly under the Green Ministry of Spirit God. Group magic was applied to them as if it was free. .

"Peng Peng Peng...!"

After a short interval of time, the saboteur fired another round of 5,000 liquid fireball shells, and the shells flew towards the bugbear clan's army square at high speed.

"Stabilize the formation! The entire army moves forward!"

The powerful Evil God High Priest, who was responsible for commanding the Bugbear clan's army to fight, calmly issued the battle order.

The evil god's camp army, composed entirely of fanatical believers, is not afraid of death at all. Such disorderly long-range attacks cannot disrupt their combat formation.

"Peng Peng Peng...!"

When the third round of liquid fireball shells launched by the Zerg Destroyer took off, the group of Zerg flying dragons that had been wandering near the battlefield suddenly rushed towards the phalanx of the bugbear army at high speed!

"Peng...!"

200 two-star and 20 three-star Zerg destroyers, based on the precise coordinates provided by the Zerg host, launched an attack on the evil god sacrificial team concentrated in the army square directly under the green ministry of the three spiritual gods!
